name: Price Shield
effect: Blocks the next hostile item/Ability or PvP coin loss; does not stack

name: Sticky Web
effect: Target's next move is at most 2

name: Pickpocket
effect: Take up to 5 coins from the target

name: Battle Ticket
effect: Force a target with a battle-ready team to accept PvP

name: Lucky Egg
effect: +1 own catch/combat until end of turn; no movement bonus

name: Potion
effect: Remove tired or a combat debuff from one of your Pokémon
